seo.title: NatWest: Cora+ digital assistant (IBM watsonx) - 10.8M queries in 2023 (2024)
seo.meta_description: Cora, NatWest's assistant, went from 5M queries in 2019 to 10.8M in 2023; Cora+ adds genAI (IBM watsonx) in June 2024.
seo.resume_citable: Cora, NatWest's digital assistant launched in 2017, went from over 5 million queries in 2019 to 10.8 million in 2023; in June 2024, NatWest added a generative AI layer, Cora+, built with IBM watsonx.

faq.q: What technology is Cora+ built on?
faq.a: Cora+ is built with IBM watsonx Assistant on IBM Cloud, after a twelve-week pilot launched in June 2024.
10.8 million customer queries in 2023, versus over 5 million in 2019.

objectif_business: Have the digital assistant absorb most of the everyday financial-management questions, then move upmarket with GenAI (Cora+) to hold more complex and more human exchanges without systematically routing to an advisor.
description: Cora is NatWest's digital assistant, launched in 2017, available on the website, the app, and social media. Its volume climbed from over 5 million queries in 2019 to 10.8 million in 2023. In June 2024, NatWest launched Cora+, a generative AI layer built with IBM (watsonx Assistant on IBM Cloud) after a twelve-week pilot: natural-language responses, understanding of complex questions (credit, mortgage), proactive assistance based on history, and conversation summaries for handoff to an agent.
points_cles: Cora digital assistant with a genAI layer (Cora+) for complex financial questions.
Built with IBM watsonx Assistant on IBM Cloud, after a twelve-week pilot.
Volume grew from over 5 million queries in 2019 to 10.8 million in 2023.

niveau_preuve.justification: Volumes published by NatWest in its official communications (T1) and the Cora+ launch documented with partner IBM (T2). Concordant volume figures over several years, but operational and not audited in financial results, hence B.

stack_technique.detail: Conversational foundation of Cora+: understanding of complex questions and natural-language responses.
Generative layer for the responses and conversation summaries passed to agents; the exact model is not named in the sources.
Support for the twelve-week pilot and then the launch of Cora+.

fonctionnement_operationnel.cadence: Real-time, 24/7, on the website, app, and social media
fonctionnement_operationnel.opere_par: NatWest Retail's digital and data team, with IBM on the watsonx layer
fonctionnement_operationnel.signal_pilote: The volume of conversations resolved without an advisor and satisfaction. If the share handled without a human drops, the service cost rises again on the contact center side.

etapes.detail: The customer asks Cora on the website, the app, or social media (balance, payment, management, product).
Cora+ answers in natural language, including on more complex topics such as credit or mortgage, drawing on the customer's history.
If needed, Cora+ passes a conversation summary to a human agent to continue without starting over.
The team tracks volumes, satisfaction, and the share handled without a human, and enriches the knowledge base.

playbook.action: Choose a pilot scope on the existing assistant (high-volume topics) and define the handoff-with-summary rules to an advisor.
playbook.livrable: Validated pilot scope and success criteria.

playbook.action: Build the GenAI layer on the knowledge base: natural-language responses, conversation summaries, access to customer history.
Pass the banking compliance, tone, and escalation tests, with adversarial question sets.
Launch the pilot in production on a fraction of traffic and measure resolution without a human and satisfaction.
Broaden the topics covered and generalize to full traffic, continuously enriching the knowledge base.
playbook.livrable: Generalized GenAI assistant with a volumes/satisfaction dashboard.

replication.equipe: 1 conversational PM + 2-3 integration devs + 1 knowledge base owner + compliance; an IBM-type partner in support.
prerequis_data: Access to customer history for proactive assistance
prerequis_orga: Choice of an assistant platform (watsonx or equivalent)
A handoff-with-summary rule to an advisor
replication.premiere_etape: Start from an already-deployed assistant and add a GenAI layer on a pilot scope, with an automatic summary for the handoff.

statut_vivant.note: Cora in production since 2017, volumes rising continuously, GenAI layer Cora+ launched in June 2024 after a pilot. NatWest also signed a multi-year AI agreement with AWS and Accenture in 2025, a sign of sustained investment.

transposable_ue.note: Deployed in the United Kingdom, under UK GDPR very close to GDPR. Cora handles financial-management questions via the app, the website, and social media; the handoff to a human and AI transparency remain to be formalized under the AI Act for an EU deployment, but the data and compliance foundation is already aligned.
